pitch_sets.interpretation: Intervals partition time at annotation changes; each expected pitch counts once, even for multiple same-pitch string labels. Present-pitch samples count expected pitches found, regardless of routing lane. All-expected coverage allows extra pitches; exact pitch-set coverage excludes them but allows duplicate voices of an expected pitch. One-voice-per-pitch coverage also excludes duplicates. Duplicates are reported, not presumed errors for same-pitch unisons. Unassigned voices establish pitch presence only. Annotated samples are unique recording time; expected/present pitch-samples are pitch-weighted time. No onset grace or release tolerance. These are raw detector MIDI durations, not snapshot matches, physical string identity, host delivery, re-pluck correctness or playable-chord success rates. An initial annotation-relative hold delay is not measured live latency. Legacy exact-string and false-output gates remain separate and unchanged.

measurement.interpretation: Distinct pitch occupancy, independent of lanes; same-pitch overlaps and touching spans merged for both detectors. Per-label durations may overlap; pitch_sets deduplicates simultaneous same-pitch annotations. No onset/release grace or fitted timing offset. Gap outputs are extra notes, not missing notes. No raw retrigger, unison-multiplicity, string, snapshot-frame, real-time latency or host-delivery result.
